Excellent food
Aug 2026 • Couples
We visited here for dinner one night, during our stay in Ho Chi Minh City, having booked in advance. Restaurant is quite small, but very nice inside. We had a couple of nice, local Vietnamese dishes which were excellent. The waiter was very nice, and he helped us with choosing our meals. We also got a visit from the owner, who said he wanted to drop by and say hello when he noticed we had made a reservation in advance, which was a nice touch. Would definitely recommend for excellent food in very nice surroundings.

A SAIGON NUGGET!
May 2026 • Couples
Discovered by chance in the street when hearing a man speaking French. This is the owner of the restaurant we decide to go to. 
The premises are small, very well maintained, the atmosphere is very pleasant. 
It is typical Vietnamese cuisine, made with fresh and quality products. 
The dishes are all excellent and very subtly flavored. 
And great surprise for dessert (there is not usually one in Vietnam) a typical Breton pancake with salted butter caramel!!!! and in addition very good!
We really enjoyed meeting the French creator of this restaurant who is an extraordinary personality!
He created another restaurant that we will soon discover.

What a secret gem!
Jan 2026 • Family
We loved our dinner here! We were looking for a place that fused the French influence with the fresh and delicious Vietnamese food experience, and we definitely found it. The space is lovely, intimate but nut cluttered. The staff is friendly and capable…and oh the food! Distinctive, delicious and fresh! We had about six dishes, sharing them all, and loved all of them! Curry, sour soup, seafood pancake, beef, spring rolls…and of course crepes! We met the wonderful
Owners and the family story behind this place is lovely. Strongly recommend Luli’sKitchen for great food and a warm and memorable experience.
